parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; Preferred qualifications are nice_to_have. Technologies appearing only under About the Job are excluded.
Read "reinforced learning" as reinforcement learning.
Mapped "AI operations" literally to AIOps, but flagged it because the model-monitoring context could instead indicate MLOps.
Vertex AI Agent Builder is treated as a distinct, unmapped product, not as a required mention of its parent Vertex AI platform; the standalone Vertex AI qualification is preferred.
Data residency, encryption, and CMEK are kept unmapped rather than adding an unnamed broad Data Privacy & Security skill.
Financial-services and regulatory knowledge are excluded as domain knowledge; discovery and PRD wording is read as product-oriented capability rather than a named technical skill.
